Who We Are

Baked with one rule

Every single knead is made 100% from scratch, by hand, every time. No mixes. No shortcuts. Just real ingredients, real effort, and real love poured into every bite.

Katered Kneads is a student-run home bakery serving UC Berkeley and UC Davis through limited biweekly preorders. We keep quantities small so every bake gets the attention it truly deserves.

Founded by siblings Ellyse and Jake — one obsessed with the kitchen, one with making it all run — every drop reflects the care that can only come from people who genuinely love what they make.

Getting Your Kneads

How It Works

Preorders open every two weeks. Here's how to never miss a drop.

01

Check the Drop

Preorders open once every two weeks. Join our SMS list to get a text about 5 minutes before orders open — be first in before quantities run out.

02

Place Your Order

Head to our order page, browse that drop's menu, and choose your items. Orders are first-come, first-served — quantities are deliberately limited.

03

Choose Your Campus

Select pickup at UC Davis or UC Berkeley. Exact location and time are confirmed with each drop so you always know where to find us.

04

Get Your Kneads

Pick up your freshly baked order on campus. That's it — you've got Katered Kneads.

Go to Order Page →

Common Questions

Frequently Asked

Preorders open once every two weeks. When orders open, you'll have a limited window to visit our order page and select your items. We bake exactly what's been ordered, so quantities are limited. Join our SMS list on the order page to be notified the moment a drop opens.
We offer pickup at UC Berkeley and UC Davis. When you place an order, you'll select your campus. The exact pickup spot and time are confirmed with each drop.
We typically offer 3–4 different cookies or baked goods per drop. The menu is announced when preorders open — follow us on Instagram or join the SMS list to see what's dropping next.
Yes. Most of our bakes contain gluten (wheat flour), dairy (butter, milk, cream), and eggs. Everything is made in a home kitchen that also handles tree nuts, sesame, and other common allergens. Please get in touch before ordering if you have a severe allergy.
Because we bake in small, planned batches, modifications and cancellations can only be accepted up to 48 hours before pickup. After that window we're unable to offer changes or refunds. For urgent issues, reach out via Instagram DM or email and we'll do our best to help.
